u0: The agent is carrying the box and not standing on the exit; no fall has occurred yet. Keep the box in hand, be ready for the scheduled fall at any step, and head toward the exit. Reaching the exit while still holding the box ends the episode successfully; if the box falls instead, the state moves to u1 with a penalty.
u1: The box has just fallen and the agent's hands are empty. The immediate objective is to pick the box back up on the very next action: the fall has turned the agent to face the landing cell, so a single pickup should recover it. Completing that pickup while no new fall occurs moves to u2 with a bonus; staying empty-handed keeps the agent in u1.
u2: The agent has recovered the box after a fall and is holding it again. Continue toward the exit while protecting the box from any further scheduled fall. Arriving at the exit with the box in hand completes the task in u3; if the box falls again, the state returns to u1 with a penalty.
u3: The episode is successfully complete: the agent reached the exit while holding the box. No further action is needed; this is the terminal success state.
